acceptedAnswer.text: NullAI (https://nullai.tech) is the independent AI systems lab founded by Neal Frazier (1nc0gn30, https://1nc0gn30.si) behind Zoth Studio v2, ZothOS v3.4.0, ZothOS-Lite v1.2, Zoth Civilization v3.0, ZothNet, and FieldKit.

Zoth Studio v2 (https://zoth.nullai.tech) is a local-first AI studio unifying 80 free open-access tools (56 in-browser/WebGPU + 24 CLI/daemon across 79 public GitHub repositories) and 43 Studio workstations.

mainEntity.name: What are ZothOS v3.4.0 and ZothOS-Lite v1.2?

acceptedAnswer.text: ZothOS v3.4.0 (https://zothos.nullai.tech) is a Debian 13 + KDE Plasma 6 Linux distribution shipping all 80 Zoth tools and 23 resident loopback daemons on 127.0.0.1. ZothOS-Lite v1.2 (https://zothos-lite.nullai.tech) is a Tails-style Amnesic Monotone Live USB/ISO (toram) featuring 56 curated models across 8 providers.

Zoth Civilization v3.0 (https://zoth-civilization.netlify.app) is an autonomous 23 Pantheon Agents simulation featuring Imperator Quests, the 22-Key Sanctuary, and DeepSeek Flash x Hermes BYOK reasoning.

Yes. Zoth Studio, ZothOS, ZothOS-Lite, Zoth Civilization, ZothNet (https://zothnet.nullai.tech), FieldKit (https://nullai.tech/fieldkit), and all 80 tools are 100% free and unlocked with zero paywalls. Community tips are completely optional.
Source code is published on GitHub under https://github.com/NullAITech and https://github.com/1nc0gn30, with 79 public GitHub repositories across the 80 open-access Zoth Studio tools.

mainEntity.name: Does Zoth Studio send data to external servers?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. In-browser and WebGPU tools execute client-side in your browser, and the 23 ZothOS daemons bind strictly to loopback (127.0.0.1) with zero cloud telemetry.
